text:
The largest recorded tree-cover loss event on this property was in 2020, at 67.7 ha, according to Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13). The other recorded events were 25.5 ha in 2015, 4.8 ha in 2017 and 0.8 ha in 2008.

All of these events happened before the 2020-12-31 baseline. In the claim period (2021–2025), no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected, and valid observations covered the whole asset. A 0.4 ha loss in 2021 was below the minimum event size, so it is not counted as an event.

Limits: changes smaller than 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. This also says nothing about regulatory compliance.
